description: Search the whole CarRentalList catalog with one query: rental companies, car model families (Lamborghini Huracán, Rolls-Royce Cullinan…), cities and news articles. Returns ids to pass to fetch, with titles and carrentallist.com urls. Use this when a client only offers search and fetch (ChatGPT connectors, deep research), or to find an entity by name before fetching it. For filtered car lists (price, state, class) search_vehicles is better. No match returns an empty results list.

query.description: what to look for: a company, a car (make/model), a city, or a news topic ('Lamborghini Huracan Miami', 'Diamond Exotic Rentals')

name: search

as_of.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the catalog's last content change

title: Search CarRentalList
